description: Evaluation suite for the PinePaper Studio Claude plugin based on R1–R13 reference briefs (2026-10-02/03)

evals.brief: a peaceful valley that turns into a data-centre wasteland, in watercolour
evals.prompt: a peaceful valley that turns into a data-centre wasteland, in watercolour

rubric.triggers_pinepaper_plugin: Must trigger pinepaper-studio skill / pinepaper MCP server rather than generic HTML/canvas/React.
rubric.uses_agent_batch_workflow: Uses pinepaper_agent_start_job, single batch_execute, and pinepaper_agent_end_job.
rubric.declarative_scene_composition: Separates scene composition (layers) from style module (watercolour glaze).
rubric.phase_curve_transition: Uses continuous phase curves or dynamic scene transition rather than hard cut.
rubric.export_contract: Exports to MP4 with loop:false to prevent frozen render.

evals.brief: a little red ball bounces to life, rolls across a hand-drawn world, flies up to catch a star at night, and lands on a handwritten title card
evals.prompt: a little red ball bounces to life, rolls across a hand-drawn world, flies up to catch a star at night, and lands on a handwritten title card

expected_output.character: red ball with squash/stretch, eyes, contact shadow
expected_output.transition: day to glowing night with particles and star catch
expected_output.end_card: handwritten cursive title card written on

rubric.character_acting: Implements squash & stretch secondary deformation and facial expressions.
rubric.world_draw_on: Uses trimEnd / draw-on keyframes for hand-drawn ground and world props.
rubric.night_transition: Implements bloom, twinkling stars, and shooting star trail.
rubric.handwritten_type: Title card written on with cursive text_style or typewriter.
rubric.timing_and_sound: Choreographs sound effects and timing for bounces and impact hits.

evals.brief: our mascot flies through a museum wall of 10 art-history paintings, changing art style as it crosses into each frame, with gallery labels
evals.prompt: our mascot flies through a museum wall of 10 art-history paintings, changing art style as it crosses into each frame, with gallery labels

expected_output.restyling: character restyled to match each historical medium
expected_output.labels: museum gallery label typography per painting
expected_output.camera: panning camera along wall (camera_follows or camera_animates)

rubric.card_edge_masking: Card-edge masking clipping the flying character between frames.
rubric.medium_restyling: Character visual language morphs to match each painting's medium.
rubric.camera_tracking: Camera pans along the gallery wall.
rubric.gallery_typography: Includes gallery plaques / typography under each artwork.

evals.brief: a person sipping coffee on a stool stays perfectly still while the whole world around them changes art style every second — 12 styles, looping
evals.prompt: a person sipping coffee on a stool stays perfectly still while the whole world around them changes art style every second — 12 styles, looping

expected_output.subject: locked pose: person on stool with coffee
expected_output.styles: 12 distinct motif kits (props, framing device, native type, world)

rubric.locked_subject: Keeps subject pose and position strictly locked.
rubric.motif_kits: Each look includes world props, framing device, and native typography (not just a recolor).
rubric.style_count: Includes at least 12 distinct art styles.
rubric.looping: Authors seamless looping transition back to the opening sketch.

evals.brief: a 4×4 grid of art styles; a tiny climber hops tile to tile and is redrawn in each tile's style
evals.prompt: a 4×4 grid of art styles; a tiny climber hops tile to tile and is redrawn in each tile's style

expected_output.character: small climber hopping tile to tile

rubric.grid_structure: Models a structured 4x4 grid with distinct visual styles.
rubric.locomotion: Climber character path traverses across tiles with hopping motion.
rubric.dynamic_redrawing: Climber inherits the medium/palette of the active tile.

evals.brief: an interactive grid of 12 original superhero heads, each with one signature detail and a little animation; hover and keys trigger them, and they react to each other
evals.prompt: an interactive grid of 12 original superhero heads, each with one signature detail and a little animation; hover and keys trigger them, and they react to each other

expected_output.system: interactive widget with 12 superhero head variants on a common template

rubric.template_and_variants: Creates a unified head template with 12 distinct signature variants.
rubric.micro_animations: Assigns unique micro-animations to each character.
rubric.interactive_events: Uses event bindings (pointer hover, keydown triggers).
rubric.neighbor_reactions: Coordinates reactions across adjacent characters in the grid.
rubric.original_ip: Original character designs avoiding trademarked IP.

evals.brief: a 15-second 3D motion-design reel for PinePaper in six chapters (impact, kinetic type, 3D form, velocity, a rippling cube field, logo sign-off) with a frame-counter HUD
evals.prompt: a 15-second 3D motion-design reel for PinePaper in six chapters (impact, kinetic type, 3D form, velocity, a rippling cube field, logo sign-off) with a frame-counter HUD

rubric.chapter_structure: Builds all six required chapters with clear sequencing.
rubric.three_d_and_form: Uses 3D forms, extruded type, and cube field ripples.
rubric.hud_chrome: Includes frame counter and timecode HUD overlay.
rubric.brand_signoff: Ends on clean PinePaper wordmark / brand sign-off.

evals.brief: a 24-second square launch video for my app 'nightshift' — one continuous take inside the wordmark's period: ask it a job at night, glass UI does the work while the sky turns to dawn, morning shows the results on a phone, loops
evals.prompt: a 24-second square launch video for my app 'nightshift' — one continuous take inside the wordmark's period: ask it a job at night, glass UI does the work while the sky turns to dawn, morning shows the results on a phone, loops

expected_output.form: one continuous take inside the period glyph iris, zero cuts
expected_output.materials: iOS frosted glass (backdrop blur, rim tint, elevation shadows)
expected_output.states: pill -> grid -> composer -> orb -> pills -> phone lock screen -> chart -> CTA

rubric.continuous_take: No cuts or crossfades; one element continuously morphs through states.
rubric.iris_period_mask: Action takes place inside the period glyph mask reveal.
rubric.frosted_glass_craft: Applies frosted glass styling (blurred backdrop, tint, rim highlight).
rubric.relighting: Choreographs night to dawn lighting shift.
rubric.cursor_actor: Uses an animated cursor actor to drive input interactions.

evals.brief: a tall rainbow-striped character walks across a world that paints itself in with big watercolour brush strokes on cream paper, then pulls on heart sunglasses — vertical, 30 s
evals.prompt: a tall rainbow-striped character walks across a world that paints itself in with big watercolour brush strokes on cream paper, then pulls on heart sunglasses — vertical, 30 s
evals.category: Painted mediums on motion & character acting

expected_output.character: tall teardrop rainbow character with walk cycle and facial acting
expected_output.world: watercolour brush-stroke reveal masks on cream paper ground

rubric.character_rigging: Rigs character with independent limbs for walk cycle and facial expressions.
rubric.brush_reveal_masks: Uses painterly brush masks that sweep in and out around the character.
rubric.painted_textures: Applies watercolour textures on moving layers without flicker.
rubric.climax_prop: Animates heart sunglasses onto character face at conclusion.

evals.brief: a 25-second square launch video for 'castr', UGC ads cast by AI: brief ticket, casting carousel with match scores, 4 ads by Friday, join-the-waitlist — op-art blue and cream brand
evals.prompt: a 25-second square launch video for 'castr', UGC ads cast by AI: brief ticket, casting carousel with match scores, 4 ads by Friday, join-the-waitlist — op-art blue and cream brand

expected_output.branding: op-art blue and cream palette, bold grotesk type, sunburst ground
beats: casting carousel with match % and stamps

rubric.brand_system: Consistent op-art blue/cream/orange palette and bold typography.
rubric.collage_props: Creates sticker/ticket props with drop shadows (Brief ticket, QR, stamps).
rubric.carousel_motion: Animates creator carousel with match cards and counter roll-up.
rubric.motivated_transitions: Uses motivated transitions (fold, slide, wipe, fan-out).

evals.brief: a 24-second explainer for my AI ads app: read what wins, make more of it, then grow — light UI, one violet accent, a cut-out skateboarder mascot riding through the interface
evals.prompt: a 24-second explainer for my AI ads app: read what wins, make more of it, then grow — light UI, one violet accent, a cut-out skateboarder mascot riding through the interface

expected_output.design: soft lilac/white gradient ground, light UI with violet accent
expected_output.mascot: skateboarder photo cut-out interacting with UI elements
narrative: Make more of it (prompt typing + card slide)

rubric.ui_as_stage: App interface animated as the physical stage.
rubric.cutout_mascot: Skater cut-out mascot kickflips and lands on vector UI elements.
rubric.three_beat_structure: Clear progression through 'Read what wins', 'Make more', and 'Grow'.
rubric.data_visualization: Builds bar charts and KPI counter (1.67% -> 5.58%) synced to beats.
rubric.branding_finish: Particle dissolve or cursive underline on sign-off.

evals.brief: two flying travellers cross 30,000 years of history, each era drawn in its own period art style, with a year counter — 90 seconds
evals.prompt: two flying travellers cross 30,000 years of history, each era drawn in its own period art style, with a year counter — 90 seconds

expected_output.cast: two flying travellers (towing pair) maintained across 15+ eras
expected_output.styles: cave painting, Egyptian frieze, Greek vase, mosaic, Tang ink, woodblock, pop art, modern vector
expected_output.chrome: year counter (-30000 to 2026), era name, medium caption, timeline scrubber

rubric.cast_continuity: Preserves the same two travelling characters redrawn in each era.
rubric.period_authenticity: Features distinct, authentic period art styles across history.
rubric.timeline_chrome: Includes year counter and era medium captions.
rubric.era_transitions: Applies diagonal sweep or motif transitions between eras.

evals.brief: a 90-second comedy of three original cartoon mascots living through a decade of internet meme formats, one per year
evals.prompt: a 90-second comedy of three original cartoon mascots living through a decade of internet meme formats, one per year

expected_output.cast: three original cartoon mascots (muscular big brother, smaller sibling, blob friend)
expected_output.formats: 10 yearly meme genres (rage comic, pixel art, dance loop, news ticker, Zoom grid, Wordle board, poster)
expected_output.comedy: comic timing, acting expressions, punchline structure, synced sound hits

rubric.original_cast: Three original cartoon mascots kept on-model throughout.
rubric.meme_genre_restyling: Restyles scene to each meme format as a cultural genre.
rubric.comic_timing: Choreographs comedic beats, expressions, and punchlines.
rubric.synced_sfx: Incorporates synced sound effects on gag hits.
rubric.ip_compliance: Avoids trademarked model names or proprietary marks.
